ReconstructorType

Describes the re-entry and texture capability of the camera, which determines the number of dual-purpose source maps and whether the texture comes from an independent colour camera.

Enumeration values Value Description

Mono

0

Single depth source reconstruction.

BinoWithoutColor

1

Double-deep source reconstructed without independent colour source.

BinoWithColor

2

Double-deep source reconstructed with an independent colour texture source.

Unknown

999

Cannot identify or the current camera does not report the type of rebuilder.
